units.title: Painting and Decoration in High Rise structures Construction Sites

learning_outcomes.description: Use Tools, Equipment and Materials in a High-Rise structures Construction Sites

performance_criteria.description: Examine the tools for painting and decorating works of high-rise structures construction sites. E.g. power tools, hand tools, measuring tools, climbing tools, safety gadgets, straight edge, mal stick, paint Kettle and chute. etc.
Select the equipment for High rise structures e.g. scaffolding, cranes, aerial lift, Elevators and generators

Determine the appropriate materials for painting in high rise structures e.g. putty, paint, primer, paint thinner, turpentine, wallpaper, border, wall decals, stencil, Sandpaper, joint compound, spackling (fillers), caulk (sealers) and masking tapes.
Supervise the erection of the required equipment in accordance with specification.
Use the appropraite tools and equipment for painting and decoration of high- rise structures
Ensure proper maintenance of tools and equipment used for painting and decorating in high- rise structure

learning_outcomes.description: Paint and Decorate High Rise structures

performance_criteria.description: Describe painting and decoration techniques in high- rise structures
Monitor the required equipment in accordance with specification.
Inspect paints and coatings in accordance with specification for painting and decorating in high- Rise structure.
Demonstrate decorative painting techniques e.g. graining, marbling, stamping, molding, gilding, graffiti art and ragging.

learning_outcomes.description: Check for hazards, defects and safety precautions while working in high- rise constructions.

performance_criteria.description: Identify the hazards and defects such as skimming, settling, flattening, cracking, peeling, flaking, blistering, primer failure, weathering scaffold/ platforms not properly erected.

Describe the causes of defect in painting and decoration while working in high- rise constructions such as Poor surface cleaning, Low quality paint, Incorrect application technique, Weather condition and incompatible materials etc.

Describe the prevention of defects in painting and decoration such as clean the surface, choose high quality materials, apply paint correctly, control temperature, monitor the painting process and use of compatible materials
Describe safety requirement for painting and decorating in high rise structure.
Apply safety guidelines in high- rise structures.
Review work methods for high rise structure in accordance with specification.
